name: job_cancel
title: Cancel Job
description: Requests cancellation of a pending server job (queued, claimed or running). Best-effort and advisory like MCP cancellation itself: the hub stops waiting, but an already-running host process may still finish on the host. Cancelling a terminal job fails with JOB_ALREADY_TERMINAL. Jobs are tenant-scoped: ids from other tenants behave as not found.

job_id.description: Server job handle returned by an earlier tool call.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

job_id.description: Echo of the cancelled job handle.

cancelled.description: Whether the job moved to cancelled by this call.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
